p0.title: Edge Functions Without Authentication
p0.description: 70+ edge functions using createPublicHandler allowing unauthenticated access to sensitive operations
p0.impact: Exposição de dados sensíveis, configurações do sistema, histórico de alertas e documentação interna sem autenticação

remediation.action: Replace createPublicHandler with createProtectedHandler for sensitive operations
steps: Audit all 70+ edge functions to determine authentication requirements
Replace createPublicHandler with createProtectedHandler for admin functions
Add role-based checks using has_role() for admin-only functions
Implement API key validation for external webhook endpoints
Add rate limiting for remaining public endpoints

p0.business_risk: HIGH - Exposição completa de configurações e dados operacionais sem controle de acesso

p1.title: 10+ SECURITY DEFINER Views Bypass RLS
p1.description: Multiple database views defined with SECURITY DEFINER that enforce RLS policies of the view creator rather than querying user
p1.impact: Bypass potencial de Row Level Security, escalação de privilégios

remediation.action: Replace SECURITY DEFINER views with SECURITY INVOKER or add explicit access checks
steps: Query all SECURITY DEFINER views: SELECT schemaname, viewname FROM pg_views WHERE definition LIKE '%SECURITY DEFINER%'
Replace with SECURITY INVOKER where possible
For required SECURITY DEFINER views, add explicit access checks
Document justification for each SECURITY DEFINER view
Consider using SECURITY DEFINER functions with proper access checks instead

p1.business_risk: MEDIUM - Potencial de acesso não autorizado a dados via views privilegiadas

p1.title: Production Readiness Function Exposes Configuration
p1.description: validate-production-readiness edge function exposes environment variables, API endpoints, database structure without authentication
p1.impact: Information disclosure aiding reconnaissance and attack planning

remediation.action: Add authentication and sanitize exposed information
steps: Restrict access to admin role only using has_role()
Sanitize error messages to remove sensitive details
Return generic 'not configured' instead of specific variable names
Move detailed diagnostics to server logs only

p1.business_risk: MEDIUM - Exposição de arquitetura e configuração facilita ataques direcionados

p2.title: React Router v7 Future Flags Not Enabled
p2.description: Console warnings about React Router v7 future flags (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) not enabled
p2.impact: Potential breaking changes in future upgrades, performance optimization not leveraged

remediation.action: Enable React Router v7 future flags
steps: Add future flags to Router configuration
Test application behavior with flags enabled

p2.business_risk: LOW - Impacto apenas em futura migração de versão

p2.title: 86 Tables with RLS Enabled but No Policies
p2.description: Multiple tables have Row Level Security enabled but no policies defined, effectively blocking all access
p2.impact: Tables may be inaccessible or overly permissive depending on implementation

remediation.action: Review each table and add appropriate RLS policies
steps: List all tables with RLS but no policies
Determine access requirements for each table
Test policies with different user roles

p2.business_risk: MEDIUM - Potencial bloqueio de funcionalidades ou acesso inadequado

p2.title: TypeScript 'any' Types in Codebase
p2.description: Multiple instances of 'any' type usage reducing type safety
p2.impact: Reduced type safety, potential runtime errors

evidence.note: Detected in types.ts and component files

steps: Define proper interfaces/types for each case
Add ESLint rule to prevent new 'any' usage

p2.business_risk: LOW - Qualidade de código e manutenibilidade

p2.title: OpenAPI Documentation Incomplete
p2.description: Only 2 of 70+ edge functions documented in OpenAPI spec
p2.impact: Difficult API integration for developers, lack of API contracts

remediation.action: Complete OpenAPI documentation for all edge functions
steps: Set up automated validation in CI/CD

p2.business_risk: LOW - Impacta documentação e experiência de integração

p2.title: Insufficient Logging in Edge Functions
p2.description: Some edge functions lack comprehensive logging for debugging and monitoring
p2.impact: Difficult troubleshooting and monitoring of production issues

evidence.note: Missing error logging and audit trails

remediation.action: Add comprehensive logging to all edge functions
steps: Add audit trail for sensitive operations

p2.business_risk: MEDIUM - Dificulta detecção e resolução de problemas em produção

p2.title: Missing Database Indexes on Foreign Keys
p2.description: Some foreign key columns lack indexes, impacting query performance

remediation.action: Add indexes to foreign key columns
steps: Identify all foreign keys without indexes

p2.business_risk: LOW - Performance impactada em queries com JOINs

p3.title: Missing SEO Meta Tags
p3.description: Some pages lack proper meta tags for SEO optimization

remediation.action: Add comprehensive meta tags to all pages
steps: Audit all routes for meta tags

p3.business_risk: LOW - Impacta apenas visibilidade em motores de busca

p3.title: Inconsistent Naming Conventions
p3.description: Mix of camelCase, snake_case, and PascalCase in different parts of codebase
p3.business_risk: VERY LOW - Apenas qualidade de código
